title: Issuance of Instructions for Uniform Procedure

content.scenario: The National Commission notices discrepancies in the hearing procedures followed by different State Commissions, leading to inconsistent consumer protection outcomes.
content.outcome: The National Commission issues instructions to all State Commissions regarding the adoption of a uniform procedure in the hearing of matters, ensuring consistency and fairness in consumer protection across the country.

user_queries: How does the National Commission ensure uniformity in consumer protection procedures?
Can the National Commission dictate procedures to State Commissions?
What is the purpose of having a uniform procedure in consumer protection cases?
